verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same problems: the top ~180px and bottom ~120px of the skyscraper are left empty, and the bottom bracket mark is blown up, blurry and much larger than the top one, so it looks distorted. 'LEARNING' runs almost to the right edge, and the photo is cropped hard against the left edge, so the content is jammed into the middle band. B leaves slightly more space under its slightly shorter photo, while A's photo is a touch larger. Neither difference changes the score.
